'''Kor Nijiladii''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA Kor Nijiladii" /> located within the [[Kor Nijiladii system/Legends|Kor Nijiladii system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Kor Hestilic system/Legends|Kor Hestilic system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kor Nijiladii was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Nijiladii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="TEA Kor Nijiladii" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Nijiladii was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the world in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" />
